findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed run's own execution arm recorded six red tests at this head that do not reproduce. exec-subset.log (revision 3785b216) reports '6 failed, 65 passed ... EXIT=1' on the five-file subset tests/test_cocos.py tests/data/test_transform_engine.py tests/latent/test_gs_solve.py tests/latent/test_harmonic_gauge.py tests/latent/test_current_diffusion.py, every failure raising imas_alambic.machine_map.MachineMapError: no bundle declares store root 'LEVEL2_DIR'. This review re-ran the identical subset at the identical head (3785b216) with the same PYTHONPATH and IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH and got '71 passed ... EXIT=0' (independent-exec-subset.log). The difference is the shared environment: resolve_description_store_root (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/machine_map.py:244) resolves LEVEL2_DIR through the imas_alambic.bundles entry point, and imas_ambix.data.bundle.load_bundle attaches it from imas_ambix.data.paths; the IMAS_ALAMBIC_MAP_PATH bundle (imas_ambix/data/bundle.json) declares no store_roots, so when the installed entry point is absent the six tests fail. The failures are therefore an environment-sensitivity of the bundle-discovery path, outside this node's scope (bundle.json and the entry point belong to the mint-move and unlock nodes), and the node's own manifest recorded them conservatively in artifacts and follow_ons. No repair is requested of this node; recorded so a reader does not take the stale red log for a head defect. The landing conclusion is unaffected.
